name: Redemption Announcement Notice Type 1 Code
definition: Specifies whether the redemption event announcement refers to certificates held only at depository or outside of depository.

DEPT.name: Depository
DEPT.definition: Event announcement will refer only to certificates held at the depository.  Used for Redemption events only.

UNVL.name: Universal
UNVL.definition: Event announcement will refer to certificates held outside of depository.
